name: Medical Care
summary: Care Capabilities Improvised Stabilisation, basic wound care, common med-stims and splints; no major surgery. Field Medicae Treat combat wounds, infection, poison and uncomplicated surgery. Hospital / Regimental Major surgery, rehabilitation, organ support and standard bionic replacement. Specialist Advanced augmetics, rare disease treatment, psychic care or xenobiological expertise. Exceptional Archeotech intervention, elite Mechanicus reconstruction or unique institutional resources.
